display.purpose: View and page titles, and the title of a dialog or floating panel (a panel is its own view). One per surface.

hero.purpose: The single big figure on Stats (cost). Rare — one per app.

title.purpose: Card and section headings. Reach for this, not Label, for anything naming a section.

body.purpose: Prose, agent messages, UI copy. Caps at ~72ch; tables and streams may run full width.

small.purpose: Metadata lines, notes, telemetry — the whispered layer.

label.purpose: Field labels and table headers. The only uppercase in the system.

code.purpose: Genuine code only: file paths, shell commands, branch refs, tool targets, inline code tokens. Never prose, names, figures, or telemetry.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Light theme: a panel floating on the canvas — grouping is the panel. Two layers, a contact shadow plus a soft ambient bloom. Never paired with a border (ghost-card ban).

shadows.name: card-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark theme: shadows fade on a dark field, so a panel is a lightness step (canvas #0E1016 → surface #171A22) plus a hairline ring.

shadows.name: bar
shadows.purpose: Light theme float: the save bar, dialogs, the conversation dock, toasts.

shadows.name: bar-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark theme float: the hairline ring does the separating work the shadow cannot on a dark field.

shadows.name: btn
shadows.purpose: Light theme: a tight cobalt-tinted contact shadow under the primary button. Not a glow.

shadows.name: btn-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark theme: the primary button carries itself on the accent lightness alone.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: The system easing: exponential ease-out. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Every hover, focus, and colour state change. Users are in flow; motion conveys state, never decoration.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: Dialog entrance. Reduced-motion alternative: animation: none.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toasts hang from under the header, so they descend into place. Gated by motion-safe: in the markup.

breakpoints.name: rail
breakpoints.purpose: Below this the sidebar collapses from a ~196px rail to a top row of icons. Responsive behaviour is structural, never fluid typography.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The view's one primary action. Cobalt fill — part of the One Cobalt Rule's budget, so never more than one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.90625rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--hm-on-accent); background: var(--hm-accent); border: none; border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 14px; box-shadow: var(--hm-shadow-btn); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--hm-accent-hot); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hm-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; background: var(--hm-accent); cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action. Surface fill with a 1px Edge border and ink text; the border darkens on hover. A border OR a shadow, never both.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.90625rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--hm-ink); background: var(--hm-surface); border: 1px solid var(--hm-edge); border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--hm-faint); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hm-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; border-color: var(--hm-edge); cursor: default; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A muted text link for tertiary actions (Rerun, Cancel, Reject…). The destructive variant hovers to Failed rose rather than ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.90625rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--hm-muted); background: none; border: none; padding: 0; margin-right: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color: var(--hm-ink); } .ds-btn-quiet--destructive:hover { color: var(--hm-fail); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hm-accent); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-btn-quiet:disabled { opacity: 0.5; color: var(--hm-muted); cursor: default; }

components.name: Field
components.description: The one form-control vocabulary. Placeholder sits at Muted (4.5:1), never Faint — a placeholder is informational text.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.90625rem; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; color: var(--hm-ink); background: var(--hm-field); border: 1px solid var(--hm-edge); border-radius: 9px; padding: 6px 10px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--hm-muted); } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--hm-accent); outline: none; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hm-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: State Pill
components.description: State text on its own tint, full-pill — the state layer in tables and the task header. Awaiting-review is the cobalt accent because it is the state that needs the operator. Draft and cancelled stay neutral (Raised/Muted): nothing is happening yet.
components.html: Awaiting review Running Draft
components.css: .ds-state-pill { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: inline-block; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-state-pill--awaiting { background: var(--hm-accent-tint); color: var(--hm-accent); } .ds-state-pill--running { background: var(--hm-running-tint); color: var(--hm-running); } .ds-state-pill--draft { background: var(--hm-raised); color: var(--hm-muted); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation: a minimal line-icon + label row. Active is accent text on Accent Tint — one of the One Cobalt Rule's six sanctioned uses.
components.html: BoardTable
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 196px; background: var(--hm-shell); padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-nav-item { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.90625rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 7px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--hm-muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--hm-ink); background: var(--hm-raised); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: var(--hm-accent); background: var(--hm-accent-tint); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hm-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Review Gate
components.description: Signature component, and the product's core promise. Two verbs only — a reviewed task merges or fails, and nothing else belongs in the row. Reject is the Ghost; Accept is the cobalt primary and sits LAST, so the affirmative holds the terminal position. Accept is deliberately unguarded, because the operator's read IS the review; Reject opens a dialog because it takes a reason, not because it needs a guard. Cancel is deliberately absent: once the work exists, "cancelled" and "failed" are two names for one terminal fact. Only the branch ref is monospace.
components.html: Merges agent/4810-dark-mode into main.
components.css: .ds-review-gate { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--hm-surface); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--hm-shadow-card); padding: 16px; } .ds-review-gate__note { margin-right: auto; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--hm-faint); } .ds-review-gate__branch { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-review-gate__reject { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.90625rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--hm-ink); background: var(--hm-surface); border: 1px solid var(--hm-edge); border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-review-gate__reject:hover { border-color: var(--hm-faint); } .ds-review-gate__reject:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hm-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-review-gate__accept { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.90625rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--hm-on-accent); background: var(--hm-accent); border: none; border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 14px; box-shadow: var(--hm-shadow-btn); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-review-gate__accept:hover { background: var(--hm-accent-hot); } .ds-review-gate__accept:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hm-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: Deck — the operator's board: one dense, structural, terminal-adjacent surface that reads the whole agent fleet at a glance, ordered by the operator's attention, in one cobalt accent over a semantic state palette. No metaphor, no costume.
narrative.overview: Harmonic is an operator's console for running and reviewing a fleet of autonomous coding agents. The UI is reorganised around the real Task/Epic lifecycle: the home is the Deck — attention-ordered panelled sections (Needs you, In flight, Landing, Queued, Recent) — and a Task opens as its own full Ticket page with a run rail that switches between its Runs. Density is a virtue here, earned by structure (panels, hierarchy, alignment), never bought with clutter. Dark is the canonical operator identity; light ships for bright rooms.
keyCharacteristics: Attention-ordered surfaces: what needs the operator now is first and loudest.
Dense and structural: grouping by floating panels, hierarchy by weight/size/colour-layer.
One cobalt accent (≤10% of any screen) plus a semantic state-signal family.
Monospace for genuine code only (paths, refs, oids, tool targets); language and figures in sans with tabular-nums.
Terminal-adjacent by restraint, never a costume — no scanlines, glow, or faux-CRT.
True dual theme with an AA contrast floor in both.
rules: One Cobalt Rule: accent only for primary action, active nav, selection, focus, chart, selected run chip, and awaiting-review — ≤10% of any screen.
Signal Rule: state colours live on the state layer (dots, pills, merge-train segments, run-chip states), never smeared across content or decorative.
Cool-Neutral Rule: neutrals carry no hue; warmth or coolness comes only from the accent and the state family.
Mono Is Code Rule: monospace only for code and code-identity tokens; everything read as language or a figure is sans with tabular-nums.
Three Weights Rule: 400 / 500–550 / 650 (750 for the Display title); add hierarchy with size or colour layer, not weight.
Grouping is the panel: a group of rows lives in one panel; never bare ruled rows on the canvas.
Attention leads: order every surface so the review gate and escalations come first.
Elevation declared once: shadow or ring, never both (no ghost card).
Standalone (non-Epic) Tasks are first-class on every surface; the Deck row is a summary, the Ticket page is the detail.
dos: Order surfaces by the operator's attention — the review gate and escalations first, loudest.
Group with panels; carry density with hierarchy and alignment, not clutter. If it reads busy, add structure before cutting content.
Set everything read as language or a figure in sans with tabular-nums; reserve mono for genuine code.
Design every change in both themes; give controls default/hover/focus-visible/disabled and every animation a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
Give every interactive control a ≥44×44px hit area and tabular readouts real table semantics.
donts: Don't reintroduce a kanban Board with drag-between-columns, or a docked master/detail Task panel — the Deck is attention-ordered rows and the Ticket is its own page.
Don't build a group from bare ruled rows on the canvas — group with a panel.
Don't set prose, labels, model/harness names, costs, ordinary ids, or telemetry in monospace.
Don't use state colours decoratively or pair a border with a wide shadow (ghost card).
Don't let cobalt mean anything but the interface's voice — tooling metadata is cyan, no second accent.
Don't tint neutrals toward any hue, use gradient text, glassmorphism, side-stripe borders, or nested cards.
Don't dress the tool as a terminal costume — scanlines, glow, faux-CRT, rotated rails are banned.
